decisions.reason: As a newly launched product with its own dedicated page, it appears to be a strategic offering the firm is likely to support beyond its first year.
Although only mentioned on the website, it fits a broader apron digitalization portfolio and is still too new for a likely near-term withdrawal.
Billing software is somewhat less central to an electrical equipment manufacturer’s core identity, but as part of an integrated airport software suite it would likely be retained for now.
Monitoring software complements equipment-related capabilities well, so a German industrial firm would usually keep developing it after launch.
As a software module tied to apron operations, it likely supports a platform strategy and would normally be given more time in the market.
A safety alert service is niche but strategically valuable in aviation operations, making a near-term discontinuation less likely than continued market testing.
